questions.q: The ______ of any clear explanation from the officials caused angry residents to hold a protest in front of the city hall this weekend.
questions.explanation: absence＝缺乏、不在，the absence of any clear explanation（完全沒有任何說明）與 angry residents to hold a protest 直接扣合；existence＝存在，the existence of an explanation 正好相反（表示「有說明」）；presence＝出席、在場，the presence of an explanation 不成句；essence＝本質、要素，the essence of an explanation 談的是「說明的本質」，不是「有無說明」。

questions.q: Many audience members ______ the young pianist, who played the entire concert from memory without ever looking at the sheet music.
questions.explanation: admire＝欽佩、讚賞，admire the young pianist（欽佩那位年輕鋼琴家）與「全程背譜不看譜」相符；advise＝勸告，advise the pianist 只能是「給他建議」；aspire＝渴望，固定搭配是 aspire to do sth，不能直接接人；impress＝使…留下深刻印象，是「事物打動人」，主語應是鋼琴家的演奏，此處應說 the audience were impressed by the pianist，語意正好顛倒。

questions.q: The research team reported a major ______ in medicine this year, and hospitals can now treat many patients within days instead of weeks.
questions.explanation: advance＝進步、進展，a major advance in medicine（醫學上的重大進展）與後面「治療時間由數週縮短到數天」直接扣合；accuracy＝準確度，指精密度高低，不會被「報導」為一項進展；advantage＝優勢，說的是對某方的好處，不是科學上的新突破；attitude＝態度，是人的心態，a major attitude in medicine 搭配完全不成立。

questions.q: The school holds an ______ book fair every spring, and this year more than two hundred students brought their used textbooks.
questions.explanation: annual＝每年的，an annual book fair（一年一度的書展）與 every spring、this year 一致；actual＝實際的，an actual book fair 不表達週期性；casual＝隨意的、休閒的，與「每年固定舉辦」無關；mutual＝相互的，an mutual book fair 冠詞與語意都不對。

questions.q: Ticket sales for the summer festival ran far ahead of last year, so the organizers ______ an even larger crowd in August.
questions.explanation: anticipate＝預期，anticipate an even larger crowd（預期人潮更大）與 ran far ahead of last year 呼應；appreciate＝感激、欣賞，appreciate a crowd 不成句；hesitate＝猶豫，固定搭配是 hesitate to do sth，hesitate a crowd 語法不通；imitate＝模仿，imitate a crowd 語意也不合。

questions.q: The coach's positive ______ kept the team calm after the defeat, and they went on to win the next three matches.
questions.explanation: attitude＝態度，the coach's positive attitude（教練的正面態度）與 kept the team calm 相扣；altitude＝海拔，the coach's positive altitude 語意不通；aptitude＝天資、才能，說的是能力而非心態；latitude＝緯度，與「態度」形近但完全無關。三個拉丁字首的選項是本題的形近干擾。

questions.q: The teacher explained that only the principal has the legal ______ to change the exam schedule this late in the term.
questions.explanation: authority＝權限、權力，the legal authority to change（變更的法定權限）與 only the principal、this late in the term 一致；ability＝能力，the ability to change 只說「有能力」不表示「有權」；accuracy＝準確度，與「能不能改」無關；anxiety＝焦慮，has the anxiety to change 不成句。

questions.q: Many students feel ______ about the entrance exam, so the school has added extra evening classes to calm their nerves.
questions.explanation: anxious＝焦慮的，feel anxious about（為某事感到焦慮）與 calm their nerves 呼應；eager＝渴望的，語意恰好相反，且固定搭配是 be eager to do sth.；envious＝嫉妒的，feel envious about 搭配與語意都不符；obvious＝顯然的，與「心情」無關。

questions.q: It took the new manager months to ______ the books, since the shop had never kept a proper record of its daily sales.
questions.explanation: balance＝使平衡、核對，balance the books（把帳目核平）與 since the shop had never kept a proper record 一致；glance＝一瞥，glance at the books 才是固定用法，glance the books 不成句；palace＝宮殿，與記帳毫無關係；budget＝預算，budget the books 語法與慣用都不成立。

questions.q: The teacher asked students to judge the story on the ______ of evidence rather than on their first impressions.
questions.explanation: on the basis of＝根據、基於，是固定片語，與 rather than on their first impressions 形成對比，答案唯一；basics＝基本要素，on the basics of 不是片語；basin＝臉盆、盆地，on the basin of 不成句；bass＝低音、鱸魚，on the bass of 語意不通。

questions.q: The newspaper was accused of ______ in its reports, because it always praised one political party and completely ignored the others.
questions.explanation: be accused of bias＝被指有偏見，與後面「只誇一方、完全忽略另一方」直接扣合；balance＝平衡，be accused of balance 不成句，語意也與「偏頗」相反；basis＝基礎，be accused of basis 語法不通；battle＝爭鬥，be accused of battle 不合此處情境。

questions.q: Most electric scooters sold here can travel about fifty kilometers on a single ______, which lasts roughly three years.
questions.explanation: battery＝電池，on a single battery（用一組電池）與 can travel fifty kilometers、lasts three years 一致；barrel＝桶，on a single barrel 談的是容器不是動力來源；bakery＝烘焙店，與交通工具無關；brass＝黃銅，既非動力來源也不符合 on a single 的搭配。

questions.q: The ______ teacher showed the class how a single cell divides into two identical cells under a powerful lens.
questions.explanation: biology＝生物學，the biology teacher（生物老師）與單細胞分裂的內容完全一致；apology＝道歉，the apology teacher 根本不存在；ecology＝生態學，談的是生物與環境的關係，範圍與細胞分裂不同；ballet＝芭蕾舞，the ballet teacher 雖可成句，但與細胞分裂毫無關聯。

questions.q: The journalist was ______ enough to publish the story that powerful companies had tried to bury for years.
questions.explanation: bold＝大膽的，be bold enough to do sth（大膽到足以做某事）與 had tried to bury（曾被壓下）呼應；bald＝禿頭的，與勇氣無關；blind＝失明的，be blind enough to publish 語意不通；broad＝寬廣的，形容範圍而非勇氣。

questions.q: To avoid the long line at the counter, the two friends waited in a small ______ near the back of the theater.
questions.explanation: booth＝小隔間、座艙，a small booth（一个小隔間）與 long line at the counter、near the back 形成對照；boot＝靴子，waited in a boot 不成句；broth＝肉湯，waited in a broth 不合常理；bone＝骨頭，同樣不成句。

questions.q: The new rule limits night flights because the noise creates a heavy ______ on families who live beside the airport.
questions.explanation: burden＝負擔，create a heavy burden on（對住在機場旁的家庭造成沉重負擔）是固定說法；band＝帶、樂團，create a heavy band on 語法不通；border＝邊界，create a heavy border on 語意不成立；burst＝爆發，create a heavy burst on 搭配錯誤。

questions.q: The new stadium was built with a ______ of fifty thousand, yet tickets for the final match sold out in a single day.
questions.explanation: capacity＝容量，a capacity of fifty thousand（容量為五萬）指可容納的人數，與 sold out 呼應；caution＝小心、警告，a caution of fifty thousand 語意不通；capability＝能力，指人的才能，a capability of fifty thousand 不合語境；certainty＝確定的事，a certainty of 指「確定的事實」，不是容量。

questions.q: After three years in the minor leagues, the young pitcher finally began his ______ in the national team last spring.
questions.explanation: career＝職涯，begin one's career（展開某人的職業生涯）與 in the minor leagues、the national team 一致；carrier＝攜帶者、運輸工具，begin one's carrier 不成句；carpet＝地毯，與棒球生涯無關；corner＝角落，begin one's corner 語意不通。

questions.q: Doctors now believe that the main ______ of the skin disease is a lack of sun protection rather than poor personal hygiene.
questions.explanation: cause＝原因，the main cause of…（…的主要原因）與 a lack of sun protection 呼應；case＝情況、個案，the main case of 不成搭配；clause＝條款、從句，the main clause of the disease 不通；pause＝暫停，與疾病成因無關。

questions.q: Because the path near the cliff was badly damaged, hikers were advised to use great ______ when crossing the narrow bridge.
questions.explanation: caution＝謹慎、小心，use great caution（格外謹慎）正符合路損後的提醒；action＝行動，use great action 語法與語意都不成立；caption＝字幕，use great caption 不成句；cartoon＝卡通，use great cartoon 語意不通。

questions.q: The mayor refused to ______ on last week's accident, saying only that the investigation would take several more months.
questions.explanation: refuse to comment on＝拒絕評論，是固定搭配，與 saying only that 呼應；command＝命令，若作動詞須接賓語，command on 不成句；commit＝承諾、犯（罪），commit on 不是搭配；commend＝表揚，固定搭配是 commend sb. on sth.，此處缺少受詞 the accident 作為 on 的內容，語法不通。

questions.q: After a careful ______ of the two designs, the judges chose the cheaper one and explained their reasons in public.
questions.explanation: comparison＝比較，a comparison of the two designs（兩種設計的比較）後接 chose the cheaper one，語意連貫；companion＝同伴，a companion of 不搭配；compassion＝同情，與設計取捨無關；confusion＝困惑，a confusion of the two designs 不成句。

questions.q: After listening to both sides, the researchers ______ that the warning was unnecessary and quietly withdrew it the next day.
questions.explanation: conclude that…＝得出…的結論，與 after listening to both sides 呼應；concede＝承認、讓步，concede that… 只表示退讓，不等於下結論；conduct＝進行、實施，conduct that 語法不通；continue 後不能直接接 that 從句作結論，此處應接 to do sth.。

questions.q: Sales of sugary drinks began to ______ sharply after the school removed all the vending machines from its hallways last summer.
questions.explanation: decline＝下降，sales began to decline sharply（銷售開始急遽下滑）與 vending machines 被撤走直接相關；decide＝決定，decide 後須接賓語，begin to decide 語法不合；define＝界定，begin to define sales 語意不通；incline＝傾斜，decline 與 incline 形近，但 incline 不與 sharply 搭配。

questions.q: The new highway plan sparked a fierce ______, with residents on both sides shouting at the town meeting.
questions.explanation: debate＝辯論、爭議，spark a fierce debate（引起激烈辯論）與 on both sides shouting 呼應；decade＝十年，spark a fierce decade 語意荒謬；dilemma＝兩難困局，spark 是「引發」爭議而非兩難；delight＝喜悅，與「居民互相叫罵」的情境相反。

questions.q: The new glassware is so ______ that even a light knock can break it, so the movers wrapped every single piece in thick paper.
questions.explanation: delicate＝易碎的，so delicate that…（如此易碎以致…）與 wrapped every single piece in thick paper 呼應；dedicate＝奉獻，是動詞，so dedicate that 語法不通；delegate＝代表，也是動詞，so delegate that 同樣不成立；decent＝體面的、還不錯的，與「怕摔破」無關。

questions.q: The waiter brought the main course out first, and the ______ arrived half an hour later, which amused the children at the next table.
questions.explanation: dessert＝甜點，the main course（主餐）之後才端上桌的自然是 dessert，與 arrived half an hour later 呼應；desert＝沙漠／遺棄，the desert arrived 不成句；descent＝下降、下降處，談的是位置或過程，不是餐點；dissent＝異議、不同意，arrive 後接 dissent 完全不合語意。

questions.q: This small ______ can measure the air quality inside a classroom within just a few seconds, and it costs very little.
questions.explanation: device＝裝置、儀器，this small device 與 can measure the air quality 相符；advice＝建議（不可數），this small advice 連量詞都不對；decision＝決定，this small decision 與測量無關；detail＝細節，this small detail 可以指小細節，但無法「測量空氣品質」，語意不通。

questions.q: The train station lies about ten kilometers ______ from our school, so most students take the bus instead of walking.
questions.explanation: distant from＝離某地多遠，ten kilometers distant from 為固定說法，與 instead of walking 呼應；distance 是名詞，說 ten kilometers distance from 語法不通（這正是本題要考的詞性陷阱）；distinct from 意為「與…不同」，不表示距離；instant＝立即的、瞬間的，instant from 沒有「距離遠」的用法。

questions.q: The school bought ______ desks that are still in perfect condition after ten years of heavy daily use by students.
questions.explanation: durable＝耐用的，與 still in perfect condition after ten years of heavy daily use 一致；delicate＝易碎的，語意恰好相反；diverse＝多樣的，談的是種類而非耐用度；digital＝數位的，digital desks 須是電子設備，與「十年耐用」無關。
